description: Put an instrument or an effect on a part of a score, or an effect on the whole score (master). A part sounds through its devices in order: its instruments first, every one of them playing every note of the part (two or more sound together as one layered sound), then its effects in the order added. Instruments, by name: sampler, synth, grand_piano, electric_piano, organ, acoustic_bass, electric_bass, synth_bass, sub_bass, strings, pad_warm, brass, flute, bells, music_box, marimba, acoustic_guitar, electric_guitar, pluck, choir; drum kits, where a pitch selects a drum: kit_acoustic, kit_808, kit_909, kit_lofi. Each named instrument and kit is recorded so its loudest note peaks at -12 dBFS at gain_db 0, which leaves room for chords and several parts. Effects, each with the params it has to be given (no value is assumed for them; the rest have defaults): eq {bands}, filter {type, cutoff_hz}, compressor {threshold_db, ratio, attack_ms, release_ms}, limiter {ceiling_dbtp}, reverb {decay_seconds, wet}, delay {wet, time_beats or time_ms}, chorus {rate_hz, depth, wet}, saturation {drive_db}, gain {gain_db}. sampler plays any media (media_id), or a time range of it, at each note's pitch, from its start for the note's length, then release_ms; one_shot plays it to its end whatever the length; root_note is the pitch that plays it unchanged; with slices, each pitch plays its own range of the media, as a drum kit does, and a pitch with no slice is silent. synth is oscillators, a filter and envelopes. A wrong name or param is refused with the full list, ranges, units and defaults (also at video://catalog/devices); score.get shows every param applied. Returns the new score_id (edit that one next) and the device_id.
